description:
TownConnect brings live South African car and property listings into ChatGPT.

Ask for what you are looking for in plain language - a hatchback in Pretoria under R300 000, a three-bedroom house in Mossel Bay, a bakkie with under 100 000 km - and TownConnect searches real, current stock from participating dealers and estate agencies. Results show photos, price, key specifications and the seller, and every listing carries a direct WhatsApp link so you can message the seller yourself.

What you can do:

- Search used vehicles by area, price, make, model, body type, mileage, transmission and fuel
- Search residential property for sale by area, price, bedrooms, bathrooms and property type
- Open any single listing for its full details and photographs
- Ask which towns and areas currently have stock, so you know where the coverage is

TownConnect reads listings only. It does not place orders, take payment, or make commitments on your behalf, and it does not see your ChatGPT account or conversation. Contact with a seller happens on WhatsApp, when you choose to start it.

Vehicle stock is currently concentrated in Pretoria, Ekurhuleni, Cape Town and Stellenbosch. Property stock is concentrated along the Garden Route, including Mossel Bay, Albertinia, George and Pacaltsdorp, and in Stellenbosch.

defaultPrompt: Show me cars for sale in Pretoria under R300 000
Find houses for sale in Mossel Bay
Which towns have car and property listings right now?
